text:
maria: heads-up: post-deploy smoke summary for r2026-04-02-02 (canary -> wave-1)

deploy-bot: synth-run=20260402-02-994321 probe=kv-prefill-warmup
- prefill_miss_rate: 1.2% (baseline 0.02%)
- upstream 503s observed on prefill fanout: spike at 02:14 UTC (wave-1 -> 30%)
- sample keys failed: 8/800

jen: seeing the 503 spike on infra dashboard, coincides with canary ramp to 30%. p95 prefill latency +180ms.

tom: paste of sanitized failed keys: ```["session:8888/pfxA","user:7777/pfxB","temp:aaaa","embed:xy12"]```

maria: can we replay quickly against r2026-04-01-23 to check regression vs data variance?

sam: replaying now on staging: `/tools/run-synth --suite=kv-prefill --build=r2026-04-01-23 --ids=20260402-02-994321 --samples=1000`

ops-bot: replay result: prior build shows prefill_miss_rate 0.03% on sampled keys

sam: so this looks introduced in r2026-04-02-02.

jen: rollout decision: propose hold further waves and pin wave-1 to r2026-04-01-23 until we triage. we should also open a runbook ticket.

maria: agree. opening runbook entry and tagging ops: https://runbook.internal/releases/994321/pin-request (maria)

deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied to wave-1. Traffic pinned to r2026-04-01-23. Canary frozen at 30%.

tom: quick investigation: PR#5038 changed prefill concurrency handling to use connection pooling; I see a small window where backpressure from downstream causes in-flight prefill retries to escalate 503s. Could be a fanout amplification due to retry timing.

sam: temporary mitigation option: lower prefill concurrency and add a jittered retry backoff for canary traffic only. ops can flip a feature-flag for canary env. Thoughts?

jen: practical path: 1) pin & hold (done) 2) enable canary-only reduced concurrency flag 3) run quick-synth to validate 4) cut hotfix if mitigation works or revert PR if not.

maria: +1. ops, can you enable canary_flag=prefill_slowdown for wave-1?

ops-bot: Feature flag toggled: canary.prefill_slowdown=true for wave-1 (applied by ops-bot)

sam: running quick-suite: `/tools/run-synth --suite=kv-prefill --build=r2026-04-02-02 --samples=1500 --flags=canary.prefill_slowdown=true`

deploy-bot: quick-suite result: prefill_miss_rate reduced to 0.05% on 1500 samples, p95 latency within acceptable delta.

jen: mitigation looks effective. recommend either merge a targeted hotfix that applies reduced concurrency more gracefully or roll back PR#5038. Which is faster?

tom: hotfix that applies connection-pool guard + jittered backoff is low-risk and small; I can cut hotfix branch and run CI. Rollback is heavier due to other perf changes.

maria: please cut hotfix and run unit + synth quick. I'll keep the pin active until we have clean synth results.

tom: hotfix branch hotfix/5038-backpressure-guard created. CI queued. ETA 18m for unit + quick synth.

ops-bot: note: alert thresholds adjusted temporarily: prefill_miss_rate auto-pause threshold lowered to 0.1% for the next 60m.

sam: CI green. running quick-suite: `/tools/run-synth --suite=kv-prefill --build=hotfix/5038-backpressure-guard --samples=3000`

deploy-bot: quick-suite: prefill_miss_rate 0.0% on 3000 samples; no 503 spikes in sampling window.

jen: approved. deploybot: please rollout hotfix to wave-1 with staged ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% and monitor for 10m at each step.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started: hotfix/5038-backpressure-guard -> wave-1 (5% initial)

ops-bot: dashboards: 503 spike gone, p95 back to baseline at 5% ramp. Canary-only slowdown flag removed.

maria: merging hotfix to main after CI and will add a regression unit test that simulates downstream 503 amplification. Also adding a synth case for high-fanout keys in nightlies.

tom: adding changelog note: "prefill: add connection pool guard and jittered retry to avoid fanout amplification under downstream 503s".

jen: postmortem action items (owners):
- add high-fanout synth sample to nightlies (sam)
- add regression test for prefill backpressure (tom)
- ensure feature-flag playbook documented for canary mitigations (maria)
- review retry/backoff defaults across prefill clients (ops)

maria: I'll draft the blameless summary and update the release notes to indicate a hotfix was shipped. ETA EOD.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout completed and full rollout resumed. Incident: mitigated. Postmortem assigned.

sam: closing thread. thanks all for the quick coordination. :rocket:
